job_description:

Head of Global Cybersecurity Operations, HSBC
Senior Cyber Security Consultant
We’re looking for an experienced cybersecurity professional with a number of years experience across the entire customer lifecycle - from pre-sales to post-sales and professional services - to join our growing Customer Success team as a Senior Cyber Security Consultant based in Saudi Arabia, covering the METNA region.
In this role, you will be the consistent value champion for Immersive from pre-sale to list sale. You will partner with our Enterprise Sales team as you conduct POVs with new & existing customers to secure the technical win, build relationships with key customers to drive business outcomes. You will be the key contact within our strategic accounts, driving platform adoption to the latest features to maximize the value of the Immersive One Platform, and executing a programmatic approach to Cyber Workforce Resilience.
Unlike traditional consultancy, which would be transactional, such as working on a single project to completion and then leaving, in this role you are embedded and dedicated to the customer for the duration of the contract. This is a long‑term and continuous engagement to provide industry and operational experience to help simplify the drive for cyber resilience by aligning and complementing an organisation's cyber strategy and vision. The customer is your number one priority, and your focus is to ensure success every step of the way to ensure they are Cyber Resilient and become more mature in this space. You need to adapt to the situations you encounter and be that trusted partner to help by utilising the Immersive One platform to its maximum. Their success is your success. It feels personal.
You will be a trusted, long‑term embedded consultant with knowledge in all areas of cyber. The customer will look to you for the answers, and you must be agile with on‑the‑spot thinking. You will interact with all customer areas, from the C‑Suite to the teams and individuals that comprise the customer's organisation. You will help everyone.
As a senior individual contributor in the team, your main responsibilities will include:
Identify and help define prospective customers’ technical requirements / use‑cases to align Immersive Lab’s technical and business value proposition
Engage C‑level executives, technical cyber security professionals, and major lines of business through delivering in‑depth solution demonstrations and managing proof‑of‑concepts
Act as a security advisor throughout the technical sales cycle by building cyber skills programs, facilitating crisis simulations, and measuring organizational risk
Partner with key customers to understand and help achieve their business, objectives, cybersecurity initiatives, and desired outcomes
Establish strategies and roadmaps to drive cyber workforce resilience through a programmatic approach
Engage C‑level executives, technical cyber security professionals, and major lines of business through delivering routine Executive Business Reviews
Leverage your cybersecurity knowledge to recommend appropriate improvements to current programs and suggest new programs.
Drive adoption to maximize the value of the Immersive Labs Platform
Immerse into cyber security community to remain informed of evolving threats, trends, and new technologies
Collaborate with product, content, and engineering teams to serve as the voice of the customer and influence product innovation
Program Management
Support customers in operationalizing and incorporating Immersive One into their cybersecurity programs sustainably, leveraging platform metrics, custom reports and insights to bring attention to the value created along the journey.
Function as an escalation point and primary liaison between sales, product leadership and client accounts, including being the first sales team resource in answering questions related to service delivery within your accounts.
With the Customer Success Manager (CSM), assist in delivering Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) to customers, providing executive‑level reports and insights that help drive long‑term account health and expansion opportunities.
Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:
5+ years work experience in an information security practitioner or solution consulting role as well as time spent working in a pre‑sales capacity.Experience within Customer Success would be highly desirable
Extensive experience in client facing roles - you will have consulted and presented to both C‑level execs and technical stakeholders
Proficiency in IT fundamentals (computer hardware/software, databases, networking, security, and software development)
Authoritative knowledge of information security concepts, domains, compliances, and standards. You are an engaging speaker and presenting, able to articulate value and discuss technical concepts in a jargon free manner
Hands‑on experience with Windows & Linux operating systems, security tools (IDS, firewalls, anti-malware, SIEM), public cloud environments, etc
Experience leading technical presentations for both technical and non‑technical audiences across all levels
Industry qualifications such as CISSP would be desirable but not essential to this role
Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:
Driven
- We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

One Team -
We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and birthday half day
Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover,
Career and learning development through the platform and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund
Share in the companies success with share options, sales incentives and Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours

We’re a sociable, tight‑knit team with monthly socials, and sports clubs. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to movie nights and escape rooms

job_description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
• *Your role and responsibilities**
As a Security Consultant in Security Strategy, Risk & Compliance Services, you will help clients understand, manage, and reduce their cybersecurity and compliance risks. As an entry-level team member, you will work under the guidance of senior consultants and managers and take part in the full engagement lifecycle.

Support cybersecurity strategy, governance, and roadmap engagements for clients across industries.

Take part in security risk assessments, including identifying assets, threats, vulnerabilities, and control gaps, and documenting risk ratings and treatment recommendations.

Help assess client security programs against frameworks and standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, and SOC 2.

Support compliance assessments and readiness activities for regulations such as GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and local data protection and cybersecurity laws.

Help develop and review security policies, standards, procedures, and control documentation.

Collect and analyze evidence from client stakeholders through interviews, document reviews, and control walkthroughs.

Support third-party and vendor risk assessments.

Help maintain risk registers, compliance tracking tools, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms.

Help prepare security awareness materials and support training sessions.

Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and incident response planning and testing activities.

Prepare clear reports, executive summaries, dashboards, and presentations that communicate findings and recommendations to technical and business audiences.

Follow professional standards, confidentiality requirements, and quality processes on every engagement.

Keep learning about emerging threats, regulations, and security technologies, and earn relevant certifications.

Work with onshore and offshore teams, and report progress, risks, and issues to the engagement lead.
• *Required technical and professional expertise**
Understanding of core cybersecurity concepts, including the CIA triad, threats and vulnerabilities, access control, encryption, and defense in depth.

Basic knowledge of risk management concepts, including risk identification, assessment, treatment, and monitoring.

Familiarity with at least one security framework or standard, such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, or CIS Controls. This can come from coursework or training.

Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, and cloud fundamentals.

Awareness of common data protection and privacy principles and regulations.

Ability to analyze information, identify gaps, and document findings accurately.

Good verbal and written communication skills in English, including report writing.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

Attention to detail, integrity, and respect for confidentiality.

Willingness to work in a team, learn quickly, and take feedback.
• *Preferred technical and professional experience**
Internship, academic project, or lab experience in risk assessment, audit, compliance, or information security.

Entry-level security certification or progress toward one, such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation or Lead Implementer/Auditor, or CISA or CISSP (for later career stages).

Exposure to GRC tools such as ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, or similar platforms.

Familiarity with identity and access management, security operations, vulnerability management, or cloud security concepts.

Basic understanding of cloud security models and frameworks, such as the shared responsibility model and CSA CCM.

Knowledge of privacy frameworks and regional regulations relevant to the client's market.

Familiarity with third-party risk management and business continuity practices.

Understanding of Agile or consulting delivery methodologies.

Experience in a professional consulting or client-facing environment, such as an internship or capstone project.

Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain security risks to non-technical audiences.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word for analysis and reporting.
